summary: Continuous-book pagination, chapter/book transitions, reflow anchors, immersive controls and commentary return are implemented and verified.
Persistent passage highlights, colors, hide/show without deletion, lookup and backup/restore are implemented and verified.
The top reference field, footer cleanup, installed-version access and reference validation are implemented and verified.
The contextual Copy/Note/Highlight/Compare bar, exact partial copying and target/lifecycle preservation are implemented and verified.
The right study drawer uses a continuous native secondary surface, preserving its controls and following.
One shared Aa control is available in the main Header Bar, including revealed immersive controls; preferences and popup lifecycle are verified.
Round chapter/page controls are positioned beside the reading text below the midpoint, with adaptive safe margins.

The client has accepted the published alpha after successful GNOME functional testing. Previously outstanding functional release checks are accepted; known remaining work remains tracked in its dedicated issues, including #56/#57 and the future study tools.
